entities.name: Xavier Eluère
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Albert Xavier Eluère was a French heavyweight professional boxer. He competed in the 1920s and was born in Issé. Eluère won a bronze medal in the 1920 Summer Olympics, losing against Danish boxer Søren Petersen in the semi-finals.
